## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `572d6b18fb5b3e2ab159f75b199b045af59df237`
Local-runs: none
Scope: ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/synth/recordTabRow.ts (`layoutRecordTabRow`), src/RecordTabRow.tsx, src/RecordPageColumns.tsx (the tabs, the counts, the active-tab face), src/index.tsx (the `ArrangedRelatedTab` export retired), src/ArrangedRelatedTab.tsx, src/RelatedList.tsx (`arrangedFull` path), src/renderers/record-related-list.tsx (the scope branch), src/RelatedCardStack.tsx (`counts`), src/RecordTimelinePanel.tsx and recordTimelineStream.ts and renderers/record-activity.tsx (动态's count), src/useRelatedArrangement.ts and synth/relatedArrangement.ts, ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx (`openEnlargedRelated` replace branch, the `ArrangedRelatedTab` use removed), the ten i18n packs (`detail.recordTabs`, `recordTabOverview`, `recordTabsMore` with plurals, `recordTabsHidden`; `relatedEnlargedBack` retired), the plugin-detail README and content/docs/ui/pages.mdx, the four new and four rewritten test files, .changeset/27524-record-page-tab-row.md, .changeset/27524-record-page-tab-row-i18n.md

Inputs: card #27524 (record page v4; the seat's PR ③ claim 6540954535 for Targets 8 and 9 cut from `main` after PR ② #28116, its amendment 6542386083 (Clause-② re-measured `yes (narrowing)`, the README and pages.mdx added to the surface, the preview gate of ruling 6520722066), the dev report 6542370280), PR #28394 (body with the target table, the layout rule, the retirements, the proxy preview review against the v4 boards at a7825499aa with its matches and the two noted differences, the file list of 36 files, the diff of 1816 lines against `main` read whole for every hand-written hunk, 5 commits from the merge-base), the 72 check-runs on this head (read 2026-10-31T11:18Z: all 72 runs completed, none failed, none cancelled, none in progress; success: Build & E2E UI, Build Docs, Build UI Deps, Check Changeset, Check Documentation Links, Dogfood Regression Gate, Governed Surface Queue Guard, Lint & Repo Gates, Lint UI, Lint · CI, release & engine gates, Lint · ESLint, Lint · PM dispatch-gates, Lint · docs & code guards, Lint · repo & tooling gates, Lint · scoped · query-options erasure, Lint · scoped · slot lookup & corpus, Lint · scoped · tooling self-tests, Live E2E UI, PR-body guards (claim · duplicate · Part-of · single-writer path), Plan Test Core shards, Spec property liveness, Test Core, Test Core (all 8), Test UI, Test UI (all 16), Type Check UI, Type Check · consumer gates, Type Check · debt ledger, Type Check · source gates, Type Check · workspace, TypeScript Type Check, filter; skipped: 18.x upgrade harness (opt-in), Auto Label, Build Core, Check PR Size, Dogfood Regression Gate (matrix shard/3), Dogfood Verify CLI, Packed-tarball smoke (opt-in), Schedule gate · skip when a green push run covers the commit, Temporal Conformance (live PG + MySQL), UI Published Artifacts), and the tree at this head for every reader of the two retired names outside `ui/packages/plugin-detail` (`git grep -w` for `ArrangedRelatedTab` and `relatedEnlargedBack` over the whole tree minus changelogs and changesets: none; the console's record view was the one importer and it is edited here), the `en.ts` keys before and after, and `RecordDetailView.tsx` on `main` (the `?related=` push and pop of #27055). The head is mergeable and clean against today's `main`; `RecordDetailView.tsx` and the ten packs moved on `main` since the merge-base (#28392) in other hunks, and the seat's merge-tree read is clean.

### ① Derived judgments

- **Target 8 is a pure rule drawn by measurement** - right. `layoutRecordTabRow` takes the measured widths, the row's width, the gap, the trigger's width, the active index and the count of always-folded tabs, and answers the shown and folded indexes: everything fits with no hidden panel means every tab and no trigger; otherwise the budget is the row less the trigger and one gap, 「概览」 and the active tab are reserved, tabs fill in order to the first that does not fit, 「概览」 plus at least one more always show, and a reserved active tab from further on lands in the last slot with the tab it displaced folding. The component measures with a `ResizeObserver` and a hidden copy of every tab and the widest trigger, so a window, sidebar or pane resize re-lays the row. Six rule cases and seven drawn-row cases pin it, and the ablation of the active-tab reservation reds both.
- **The counts are one set** - right. The page asks `useRelatedCounts` once for every panel, hidden ones included, and hands the same counts to the right column, which then asks for none itself; 动态's count is the stream's own, reported by the `record:activity` block through the panel's `count` / `onCount` and the context on the 动态 tab. The read at open grows by the hidden panels' counts only, through the same deduplicated `RelatedCountStore` requests; nothing else a record open fetches changes, and the data adapter is #28321's, untouched here.
- **Target 9 keeps the URL contract and fixes the history** - right. The face is a `tabpanel` under the row at full width with the header untouched; `?related=object.field` and `?related=timeline` stay the addresses, so a reload and a shared link still open the tab. Leaving 「概览」 pushes one entry as #27055 did; moving from tab to tab now replaces it, keeping its state, so Back, Esc and 「概览」 all return to the page in one step, and a deep link's 「概览」 replaces the address since nothing was pushed. Three cases on the browser's own history pin it, and the ablation of the replace branch reds two.
- **The retirements are what the declaration of record says** - right. `ArrangedRelatedTab` laid the reader's arrangement over the 关联 tab of the tabbed tier PR ② retired, and the console's record view was its one importer; it leaves the entry with its `arrangedFull` chrome path and the renderer's scope branch, and a page still drawn as its strip is drawn as written. `detail.relatedEnlargedBack` was the back line the active tab replaces; it leaves all ten packs, and `TranslationKeys` narrows by one key under the `runtime-interface-only` marker as PR ① and ② did. The lane's grep finds no other reader of either name. `Metadata-protocol: none` holds: no spec path, nothing an author writes.
- **The accessibility contract is whole** - right. The row is a `tablist` named by `detail.recordTabs`, one tab stop with arrow, Home and End movement and Enter or Space to open; the trigger carries `detail.recordTabsMore` with plural forms in every pack; the face is a `tabpanel`. The rewritten tier pins assert the page's only tablist is this row on every tier and embedded.
- **Check-runs as gate verdicts** - read as above; every latest run per name on this head completed green or skipped (one `Check Changeset` run was cancelled and superseded by its green re-run two minutes later).

### ② Semver level

- **`@object-ui/plugin-detail`, `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/i18n` patch with the `!` titles and the `**BREAKING**` banners** - accepted. A ui package takes `patch` for a `!` retirement by the #28116 precedent; each changeset carries the ADR-0087 `not-required` marker naming its operand and a FROM → TO line.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **The enlarged face keeps `RelatedList`'s own card header and foot** - the v4 board draws a bare toolbar (filter, 全部 / 我的 / 逾期, 新建, 导出) over a table filling the height; the related list has no such toolbar today. Noted in the preview review and the known gaps, not changed here; the seat's preview gate before ACCEPT is where that difference is ruled, and it is worth a line on PR ④ or a follow-up card so it is not lost.
- **动态's count on a deep link** - absent until the stream is drawn once, since only the stream reads its size. Known gap, recorded.
- **Hidden-panel counts at open** - a small read increase per hidden panel, deduplicated; accepted as the price of showing counts on their tabs.
- **The seat lands** - no Tier H path (no `docs/adr`, no `skills/**`, 1816 lines, under 3000), no human gate; no name approval owed (ui component and i18n keys, no spec key). The preview gate against the v4 boards (ruling 6520722066) is the seat's own step before ACCEPT.

### ④ Design judgment

- Tried: a row where the active tab alone is wider than the budget (reserved regardless, with 「概览」; the rule never drops it); `activeIndex` out of range (read as 0); a page with only 「概览」 (no row drawn, by the component's guard); a tab change while the pane is maximized (same view, same replace). Keeping the rule pure and the measurement in the component is what makes the fold deterministic for a given width. Nothing to add.

**Verdict reasoning.** The tab row is a pure width rule drawn by measurement with the active tab always on the row, the counts come from one deduplicated set, the enlarged face is the active tab under the untouched header with the same URL addresses and a history that returns in one step, the two retirements have no reader left and are declared with their markers and the right level, the row and face carry their roles and names in every pack, the pins hold both ways including on real browser history, and every latest check on this head is green or skipped.

Implemented-by: `claude/project-thread-hh88jx`
Reviewed-by: `session_01L9qibw58ehQ2gRHP2h2Puz`

**VERDICT: PASS**

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:记录页头部下面多了一行常驻标签(概览、动态、各关联列表,带条数);放不下的按行宽收进「+N ▾」,当前标签永远在行上。点开关联列表 = 切到该标签,整宽列表画在标签行下,地址仍是 `?related=…`,概览或 Esc 返回。
- 为什么改:#27524 记录页 v4 的 Target 8、9(第 ③ 段);第 ④ 段(顶栏)因 ui 车道收班未开,留在卡上。
- 风险与回滚:只动 ui(plugin-detail、app-shell、语言包)和文档;退役一个只有控制台用过的导出 `ArrangedRelatedTab` 和一个语言键(条款② 收窄,标题带 `!`)。开页会多取隐藏面板的条数,经同一计数缓存去重。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`plugin-detail/src/RecordTabRow.tsx` 与 `synth/recordTabRow.ts`(放几个的规则)。
- 两分钟验证:打开一条客户记录,拖窄窗口,标签逐个收进「+N ▾」;点一个关联列表标签,地址带 `?related=`,按 Esc 回概览。
- 需要你做的:合并需要你在席位线程里说一句(会话安全审核不认常设授权)。
- 席位意见:同意。预览对照 v4 画板通过;放大列表仍是卡片头尾、不是画板上的工具栏,这一差异与第 ④ 段一起留在 #27524。
